name: Bishoujo Audition - Idol o Sagase!
original_name: 美少女オーディション アイドルを探せ！
source:
The previous winner of MISCON left it with a scandal and now the reputation of the competition is on stake. Only the best candidates should pass the audition.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-february-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
上一屆MISCON冠軍因醜聞離開，如今比賽聲譽岌岌可危。只有最優秀的候選人才能透過試鏡。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/06/vn-of-month-february-1993.html]vndbreview[/url]]
